verdict.rationale: Base44 ships its own programmatic surfaces: a CLI that creates projects, syncs data models and code, deploys resources and runs commands against any app; an SDK with entity CRUD; an account-level MCP server; and sandbox access for external agents. Nothing shows these reach parity with the UI, and the OpenAPI probe found no published API spec. missing for 10: documented UI/API parity, programmatic coverage of UI features like custom domains, login configuration, templates, design tooling and AI-chat building, a published API reference/OpenAPI spec, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Create new backend projects, sync data models and code, deploy resources, and run commands against any app on your account
The Base44 MCP server exposes your Base44 account to any MCP-compatible AI assistant.
entities: Work with your app's data entities using CRUD operations.
Bring your own AI coding agent, or your own scripts, to a Base44 app by connecting to its sandbox.
Your entire backend is defined in code and configuration files, making it easy for AI coding agents to build and manage your project.
